Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in this position. I am currently pursuing a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology at Florida International University, with a minor in Public Administration/Public Policy, and I am expected to graduate in Spring 2028. Through my academic, professional, research, and community-service experiences, I have developed strong communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills that I would be excited to bring to your organization.

My experience includes working in customer-facing environments, volunteering extensively in community food distribution, and participating in leadership and research opportunities at FIU. Through my community service with the Fort Lauderdale Housing Authority and Feeding South Florida, I contributed more than 300 hours supporting food distribution efforts and assisting with the organization and distribution of approximately 12,000 food boxes annually. These experiences strengthened my ability to work with diverse populations, collaborate with others, and remain dependable in fast-paced environments.

In addition, my experience as a McNair Scholar and undergraduate researcher has strengthened my ability to conduct research, analyze information, communicate effectively, and approach complex issues thoughtfully. My involvement in student organizations and campus leadership has further developed my ability to manage responsibilities, work as part of a team, and contribute to a larger organization.

I am also fluent in Spanish, which allows me to communicate effectively with both English- and Spanish-speaking individuals. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute my skills, work ethic, and commitment to serving others to your organization.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my experiences and qualifications align with this position.

Sincerely,
Nicole Ballen
